### Firmware
- AS7331 re-initialised automatically when it reads all zeros (−66.9 °C) after losing its settings. / AS7331 jest automatycznie ponownie inicjalizowany, gdy po utracie ustawień czyta same zera (−66,9 °C).
- Includes the 2.5.0 changes (repaired triad reads, triad channel correction in the app). / Zawiera zmiany z 2.5.0.

Upload [firmware/tdisplay-s3-sensors/tdisplay-s3-sensors.ino](https://github.com/radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer2.0/tree/main/firmware/tdisplay-s3-sensors).

### Offline package
Unzip `WebSpectrometer2.0-v2.5.1.zip` and serve the folder, e.g. `python3 -m http.server 8000`, then open http://localhost:8000.
